description: Read the root (Windows: Administrator) password of a keyless VPS — shown ONCE. It is returned only after the VM has finished booting: at that moment the password is applied to the live VM, so it is guaranteed to work. While the VM is still booting the response carries `password_pending: true` and NO password — call again in ~30-60 s (the one-time reveal is NOT spent until a password is actually returned; no reset or reboot needed). After it has been shown once, later calls return no password: save it right away. Lost it? `reset_password` (needs confirm = hostname), then reveal_password again after ~20 s. If you ordered with an SSH key, you do not need a password — log in with the key. The response is the same server detail as get_vps_status plus the password. Requires: token + a keyless VPS. Typical: password_pending=true while the VM boots — not an error, call again in 30-60 s; no password after it was shown once → reset_password.

service_id.description: Optional. Service code as returned by list_vps/order_vps, e.g. "68J67T5" (a plain numeric id is also accepted).

name: reveal_password
title: Reveal root password (once)
